# Reasons for Not Drinking

Use this worksheet to reflect on:

-   Reasons for **not drinking**
-   **Unpleasant consequences** of drinking
-   **Stumbling blocks or high-risk situations** that may make it hard to stay abstinent

[Click here to open this worksheet as a PDF.](https://github.com/jjcurtin/aud_support/blob/main/modules/worksheets/reasons_for_abstinence.pdf?raw=true)

List **5–10 reminders in each category**, then transfer them to a pocket-sized card. Read the card whenever you begin to have thoughts about drinking.
